V. CONCLUSION
The proposed improvement of Lincoln Highway between Cicero Avenue and Chicago Road is expected to have no significant adverse impact upon land owned by the Cook County Forest Preserve District. The proposed improvement contains constructive measures to enhance the Section 4 (f) Land and all possible planning to minimize harm has been taken. It has been determined that no other alternate is feasible or prudent to avoid the temporary use of 0.17 acres of Section 4 (f) Land from the Cook County Forest Preserve District as a temporary construction easement for removal of bridge wing walls from the existing structure over Thorn Creek and the necessary rebuilding of the Forest Preserve District driveway to a more desireable and safer gradient.
